products.title: Miniature Rose
products.description: Petite rose bush full of delicate buds and blooms, presented in a decorative container pot. Ideal for patios and bright window areas.

symbolism.origin: Developed from historic Chinese dwarf roses; in Victorian floriography, miniature roses symbolize delicate charm, youthful romance, and heartfelt simplicity.

growing_instructions: Pot or repot in nutrient-rich loamy mix in March or April as new growth commences.
Flushes repeated sprays of tiny roses from May through October with regular deadheading.
Hardy outdoors, but protect container roots from freezing through by sheltering pots against walls or in cool verandas Dec-Feb.
Prune stems back by one-third in late February before spring bud break.
care_instructions: Water deeply when top 2-3 cm of potting media feels dry; avoid wetting leaves at sunset.
Feed every 3 weeks with balanced seaweed or organic rose feed during active bud flushes.
Deadhead spent blooms above an outward-facing 5-leaflet leaf to stimulate fresh buds.
Protect pots from deep freezing soil in harsh Kashmir winter with burlap insulation.

products.title: Flowering Kalanchoe
products.description: Succulent kalanchoe with fleshy green foliage and long-lasting clusters of vibrant blooms in a desktop pot.

symbolism.origin: Celebrated in Asian botanical traditions and European floristry as a plant of endurance, prosperity, and continuous affection due to its enduring blooms.

growing_instructions: Repot into well-aerated succulent mix in April or May after winter flowering fades.
Builds lush fleshy foliage outdoors in partial shade from June through August.
Requires heated indoor placement from November to March; blooms prolifically indoors from December through April.
Water only when soil is dry to the touch, avoiding standing water in saucers.
care_instructions: Allow soil to dry out almost completely between waterings; avoid standing water in saucers.
Feed with diluted low-nitrogen succulent fertilizer once a month in summer.
Trim spent flower stalks at base when blooming cycle finishes to encourage lush foliage.
Provide 14 hours of daily darkness for 6 weeks in autumn to re-induce flower bud formation.

products.title: Garden Geranium
products.description: A colourful zonal geranium with vibrant flower clusters and rounded, often patterned foliage. Ideal for sunny balconies, windowsills, patios, and container displays.

symbolism.origin: Garden geraniums, commonly classified as Pelargonium cultivars, have inspired varied symbolic meanings across flower colours and Victorian floral traditions. Their abundant blooms and distinctive foliage evoke friendship, comfort, and positive feelings.

growing_instructions: Grow in a well-draining potting mix and place in a sunny location with several hours of sunlight daily.
Move outdoors during frost-free weather in spring. Flowering can continue through summer and autumn under favourable conditions.
Protect from frost during Kashmir winters by moving the pot to a bright, frost-free indoor location.
In early spring, remove dead growth and trim leggy stems to encourage compact, bushy growth.
care_instructions: Water thoroughly when the upper layer of potting mix has dried, allowing excess water to drain freely.
Apply a balanced flowering-plant fertilizer during active growth according to the product label.
Remove faded flower clusters and yellowing leaves to maintain a tidy appearance and encourage further flowering.
Pinch back young shoots when needed to promote bushier growth.
Inspect periodically for aphids, whiteflies, and fungal problems, particularly when ventilation is poor.

products.title: Flowering Begonia
products.description: Lush flowering begonia boasting delicate petals and ornamental foliage, potted in a decorative container.

symbolism.origin: Named after Michel Bégon; its sound-alike phrase “be gone” suggested caution.

growing_instructions: Plant tubers or potted nursery starts in moist, shaded containers in late April or May.
Lush waxy blooms flower continuously from June through October in dappled shade.
Very sensitive to cold and frost; move indoors or store dormant tubers frost-free from November to March.
Reduce water in winter; resume regular watering in April.
care_instructions: Keep soil consistently moist to touch but never soggy.
Water around the base; avoid getting water on hairy foliage and flower petals.
Feed every 2 weeks during peak flowering with mild liquid fertilizer.
Reduce water in late autumn as natural seasonal rest begins.

products.title: Fuchsia
products.description: An elegant flowering plant with dangling, bell-shaped blossoms in contrasting colours. Ideal for adding graceful colour to patios, balconies, and verandas.

symbolism.origin: Native to the Americas and parts of the Pacific, fuchsia was named in honour of German botanist Leonhart Fuchs. Its graceful, pendulous blossoms have inspired associations with confiding love, amiability, and delicate elegance.

growing_instructions: Grow in rich, well-draining potting mix and place in partial shade or gentle morning sun.
Enjoy the main flowering display from summer into autumn, provided the plant receives adequate light, water, and nutrients.
Protect from frost in Kashmir. Move the pot to a cool, frost-free location before freezing temperatures arrive.
During winter dormancy, reduce watering and keep the compost slightly moist rather than waterlogged.
Prune in early spring, removing dead growth and shortening stems as needed to encourage fresh, bushy growth.
care_instructions: Check the compost regularly and water when the surface begins to dry; container plants may need daily watering during hot weather.
Apply a balanced liquid fertilizer during active growth according to the product label.
Remove spent flowers to encourage continued blooming and maintain a tidy appearance.
Ensure the pot has drainage holes and never leave the roots sitting in standing water.
Inspect for aphids, whiteflies, and spider mites, treating infestations promptly.

products.title: Flowering Azalea
products.description: Spectacular blooming shrub covered in massed petals, potted in a premium ceramic planter.

symbolism.origin: Azaleas are short-lived and sensitive to excess water, symbolizing fragility and restraint.

growing_instructions: Plant in acidic, ericaceous peat-rich compost in early spring in March or autumn in October.
Produces an explosion of vibrant ruffled blooms from April through May.
Moderately hardy; protect container roots from freezing solid by placing on sheltered porches Nov-Feb.
Prune lightly immediately after flowering in June; never prune in autumn or winter when buds are set.
care_instructions: Water with rainwater or soft water to maintain soil acidity; keep root ball consistently moist.
Prune lightly immediately after blooming stops in late spring.
Feed with specific ericaceous acid-loving plant fertilizer in spring.
Mulch pot surface with pine needles to retain cool root moisture.

products.title: Hydrangea
products.description: Stunning large mophead blooms in a decorative container pot. Instant garden color and elegance.

symbolism.origin: Large blooms with few seeds suggested excess show.

growing_instructions: Pot in moisture-retentive loamy compost and place in morning sun or partial shade in April.
Large mophead flower clusters open in June and hold colorful heads through September.
Deciduous and winter hardy; stems overwinter dormant from November to March under thick mulch.
Prune spent flower heads in late winter in February down to the first pair of healthy plump buds.
care_instructions: Hydrangeas have high water requirements; water deeply daily during warm summer spells.
Top-dress with organic mulch to prevent surface evaporation.
Deadhead flower heads in late winter above the first pair of healthy plump buds.
Feed in early spring with balanced slow-release granular plant food.

products.title: Chrysanthemum
products.description: Decorative potted mum blooming with dense, colorful daisy-like flower heads.

symbolism.origin: Commonly used in European funerals and All Souls’ Day rituals.

growing_instructions: Pot rooted cuttings in fertile garden soil in May or June.
Pinch growing tips until mid-July to build bushy branching and abundant bud sites.
Srinagar's autumn centerpiece: blooms in vivid splendor from September through November.
Cut stems back to soil level after flowering in December; crowns overwinter safely under mulch.
care_instructions: Water consistently at soil level; avoid wetting leaves to ward off powdery mildew.
Pinch back stem tips until mid-July to create dense, multi-branched floral domes.
Feed with high-potassium fertilizer every 2 weeks once buds form.
Cut back dead stems to base after winter frost finishes flowering.

products.title: Gerbera Daisy
products.description: Cheerful, bold flowering gerbera daisy potted for bright indoor or patio spots.

symbolism.origin: Named after German botanist Traugott Gerber; in the language of flowers, the wide-open, cheerful rays and vivid palette of gerberas symbolize unabashed joy and pure innocence.

growing_instructions: Plant in porous, well-draining soil keeping crown slightly above soil level in April or May.
Produces vibrant daisy blooms on sturdy stalks from May through September in bright sun.
Tender to Kashmir sub-zero freezes; bring pots indoors to a warm, sunny room from November through March.
Water at the soil base only; keep barely moist during winter dormancy from December to February.
care_instructions: Water deeply only when the top few centimeters of soil feel dry.
Never let water settle in the central crown rosette.
Fertilize every 2-3 weeks with balanced bloom-booster fertilizer.
Pull spent stems gently from the base rather than cutting halfway.

products.title: Calla Lily
products.description: Graceful trumpet-shaped ivory spathes with deep green foliage in an elegant container pot.

symbolism.origin: Its pure white spathe and flawless, sculpted form made it a symbol of regal magnificence in Victorian parlors and bridal ceremonies.

growing_instructions: Plant rhizomes in humus-rich, moist potting mix in April after freezing risks subside.
Elegant architectural spathe blooms unfurl from late May through August.
Tender to outdoor winter freezing; move pots indoors or lift rhizomes in October before frost.
Store dormant rhizomes in dry peat at 10-15°C from November through March.
care_instructions: Keep soil evenly moist during active growth and blooming flush.
Feed monthly with liquid potassium-rich fertilizer while flowering.
Withhold water in late autumn to allow rhizomes to enter mandatory dry winter dormancy.
Store dormant rhizomes in a dry, frost-free location during sub-zero winter temperatures.
